description: MCP server for the Horoshop e-commerce API — orders, catalog, customers, webhooks
name: io.github.ecomkit-com-ua/horoshop

environmentVariables.description: Store domain, e.g. myshop.com.ua (with or without https://)
environmentVariables.name: HOROSHOP_DOMAIN

environmentVariables.description: Login of a dedicated admin account created in the Horoshop panel (Налаштування → Адміни)
environmentVariables.name: HOROSHOP_LOGIN

environmentVariables.description: Password of that admin account. Horoshop has no API keys, so admin credentials are used
environmentVariables.name: HOROSHOP_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to hide every tool that writes to the store. Recommended for a first run
environmentVariables.name: HOROSHOP_READONLY

environmentVariables.description: Cap on a single tool response; larger exports are truncated with a note
environmentVariables.name: HOROSHOP_MAX_RESPONSE_BYTES

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to use plain http instead of https (dev stores only)
environmentVariables.name: HOROSHOP_INSECURE_HTTP
